title: I finally got around to building a backpack battler that fit my taste for roguelite power fantasy
author: TheWellKnownEIP
selftext:
I love chasing the roguelite "godlike" runs in RoR where planning and commitment pays off, but hadn't found a backpack battler game that really scratched that itch. 

I took a PRD software engineering approach to the problem to setup a Claude Code pipeline which managed the gameplay, translating systems and mechanics and Codex for the art pipeline. Using ChatGPT for keyframes and Gemini for small edits like colour swaps.

I think the biggest learning was building a "scenario" harness where the agent could spin up an exact game state in the real build (hero, inventory layout, enemy waves, frozen time), then click, drag items, and dump the adjacency bonuses as JSON. That made reproducing bugs much easier instead of guessing from the code or wasting a lot of tokens to try and find it. 

The one thing that I kept for myself was balance and play testing, I tried automated balance gates but removed them because they didn't capture what made it really fun.

If you're interested in the process happy to answer any questions! 

Also if you want to check out the game [**here**](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5380750/Backpack_Ascendancy/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=aigamedev_launch_post), I'm hoping to release in the next month or so!
